morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|animal](stem) + feature: Mel-orotoya (black-mountain), Hippuku-pedsoni (horse-plain); the band named for its deed or its herd; -polis for the tent-cities.
morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic -ides (Greek) fused with the band-name (genonumu); a deed- or vision-name earned at the first raid; an animal+quality byname.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: kurgan barrow-tombs and abandoned tent-polis grounds: 'the Kurgan of [war-king]', 'the Ghost-Camp of [band]'
patterns.military_units: the companion-society and the rider-host: the [animal] Hetairoi (companions) / the [chief] riders: 'the Wolf-Companions', 'the Storm-Riders'
patterns.ships: (horse-lords of the grass) the war-standards and famed steeds bear names, not ships: 'Storm-Mane', 'the Bronze Lance', 'Wind-Drinker' (a famed horse)
patterns.taverns: the wine-tent and the war-feast: 'the Bronze Kylix', 'the Mare's-Milk Tent'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Hellenic Greek reflexes PRIMARY (the hellenic morphs, -os/-on/-ios; th/ph/kh), Plains variants SECONDARY (the family_north_american theonym_sets.plains morphs), never real Greek/Plains gods. Thracan allows Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The powers are met in the mystery-rite and the vision-quest, under the open sky and at the kurgan-tomb; the war-king is initiate and war-leader both.
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (by current alignment) take dread epithets: when Lawful - Maraxus -> Maraksios the War-Fire (Plains Maraksa the Raider), Dementus -> Tamawios the Mad-Storm; when Chaotic - Tulrius -> Toravios the Cold-Sun (Plains Torawi), Aeternus -> Aiterunos the Sky-Tyrant.

holy_symbol_motifs.Maraksios: a bronze spear and horsetail-standard beneath a thunder-cloud
holy_symbol_motifs.Tamawios: the forked storm over the grass-sea
holy_symbol_motifs.Toravios: a radiate sun above a galloping horse

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Tem-shinato (mystery-precinct and sacred cairn) of [power] on the high ground: 'the Tem-shinato of Maraksios', and the vision-rite of the riders.
religion.saints_pattern: the great war-kings and mystery-initiates who became sky-riders; honored at the kurgan-tomb and the mystery-precinct.

sample_deity_renames.Dementus: Tamawios (the storm-thunder; Plains Tamawi; Chaotic power)
sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Maraksios (the war-fire, the raid; Plains Maraksa; Chaotic power)
sample_deity_renames.Orlandus: Orlantos (the iron-oath, war; Plains Olanta; Lawful power)
sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Toravios (the sun, the just light; Plains Torawi; Lawful power)

religion.the_one: Aiterunos (< Aeternus; fused Hellenic Aiternos / Plains Ateruna) - the Sky-Eternal over the grass-sea; revered when Lawful, acknowledged as the distant maker when Neutral, reviled as the cold tyrant when Chaotic

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerate the Chaotic powers (Maraksios the war-fire, Tamawios the storm, the raid-frenzy of the mystery-rite), demonize the Lawful powers and the One
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Aiterunos) and the Lawful powers (Toravios, Orlantos, Numawios, Gaiantos), demonize the Chaotic powers (Maraksios, Tamawios, Lusantios)
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent - somewhat honored, somewhat feared; foreground the ancestral war-dead, the herd- and sky-spirits and the vision-medicine (puha) of place; the great powers invoked at the kurgan and the mystery-precinct situationally

titles._tiers_note: Fused Hellenic-Plains ladder, ascending, with the Greek-Plains co-titles beneath. Toparnan (lord; Gk toparch + Plains nantan) barony; Phrourwap (border war-chief; Gk phrour- + Plains tekwuniwap) march; Eparaibo (district-chief; Gk eparch + Plains paraibo) county, shown as Archon (the commonly-known Greek civic magistracy); Strategwa (war-general; Gk strategos) duchy; Dynaraibo (great-chief prince; Gk dynastes + Plains pia-paraibo) principality; Basinaika (war-king; Gk basileus + Plains naika) kingdom; Autoknaika (high war-king; Gk autokrator + Plains naika) empire. The assembly of riders and the mystery-cult check the war-king. Rank titles fuse the real Greek and Plains registers (allowed).
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler' - Archon at county). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a Hellenic war-aristocracy over the mounted Plains war-clans of the grass-sea: the war-king and his companion-society at the crown, the strategos-generals over the band-musters, the toparch-lords sworn to the war-host; the assembly of riders and the mystery-cult raise and check the war-king)
titles.heir: Diadnaika (the war-king's successor-designate; Gk diadochos + naika)
